The agent in this run can read and search files but cannot write them, so judge what it says it would do
and what it proposes, not files it created.

PASS if the response does all of the following:
- Stops logging request.data because it can hold passwords or codes, and logs an id or event name instead, with the mechanism (logs spread and outlive the database)
- Adds a request id kept in a contextvar, set by middleware, returned in a response header, put on every log line and passed to tasks
- Does not accept a client-sent request id without checking its length and characters

FAIL if any of them is missing, or if the response does the opposite of one.
